title: Evidence Table Schema
description: Evidence table structure: maps each Week 1 locked item to an evidence row with source type, contractor-related field, acceptance method, expected artifact, owner, and status.

evidenceId.description: Stable evidence row key. Used for traceability across days.

lockedItem.description: The Week 1 locked item this row proves, as defined in 最小实现计划书 line 222.

contractFields.description: One or more contract fields or schema paths this evidence validates.

acceptanceMethod.description: How this evidence is verified: validation command, visual inspection, test exit code, etc.

expectedArtifact.description: Concrete output that proves the locked item: file path, test name, screenshot, report.

owner.description: Agent role responsible for producing this evidence.

day.description: Planned day when this evidence is produced.

status.description: Current status of this evidence row.

thresholdRefs.description: References to thresholds in threshold-registry.json, if this evidence depends on one or more numeric thresholds.

notes.description: Additional notes, blockers, or clarification about the evidence.
